source_title: IJSO 2022 Theoretical Test official answer/marking booklet
format_and_scope: Direct Korean text and image-label translation authored by Codex with no external translation API.
The unchanged original logo inscription is part of the organizer artwork.
The periodic table retains the source legacy symbols, original atomic masses and structure. The four unknown-mass captions have Korean labels.
All graphic asset programs persist unchanged. Existing English image labels are replaced by localized overlays, retaining plotted values, marks and diagram geometry.
Native Latin and formula glyphs retain original font resources. Some Arial and Times New Roman face programs were unembedded in the source. Korean text uses Korean family counterparts.
The original embedded Roboto subset was used solely for text fully localized into Korean and is unused in the final layout.
The 39-page marked booklet reproduces the printed question exam instruction that references 37 pages, because the original question paper is 37 pages.
This is a marked official document with filled answers, work and scoring annotations. Blank-sheet file availability is independent.
